edges: The work presents a view from Manhattan of the rest of the world.
The illustration depicts Manhattan's 9th Avenue, 10th Avenue, and the Hudson River while showing the world with a back turned to Europe.
The artwork is studied by art students globally and is associated with Manhattan's perception of the country beyond the Hudson River.
